content.value: Using simple queuing theory derive: $P _ { n } = \rho ^ { n } ( 1 - \rho )$ ,where ρ means traffic intensity, n (15) means number of items and $P _ { n }$ means possibility that the queuing system has n items at a given time. (The service pattern is exponentially distributed and the flow has a poissonian arrival pattern).
